column2: Bhukisha, hambisa uze ugqibezele imali yepasile nganye — inkqubo enye yeepasile kwizixhobo zakho.

Abathengi nababoneleli, iincwadi, i-COD, iilebheli, amaqoqo eenombolo ze-AWB, ukulandelela, abahambisi neebhili — wonke umjikelo ukusuka kwikhawuntara ukuya ekugqityweni kwemali, nokuba ikhona i-intanethi okanye akukho. Simahla kwizixhobo zakho.
Ubunzima bokwenyani nobunzima bevolumu, ecaleni kobunye nobunye.
Ikhadi lakho lamaxabiso, imali ephathekayo okanye i-akhawunti.
Ukucofa kanye kucoca ikhawuntara ukuze kungene ofikayo olandelayo.
Skrola — umzila wohambo lwepasile ngentla ubonisa apho ukhoyo ebalini.
Ubunzima bokwenyani okanye bevolumu — obukhulu kunobunye, bujikelezwe ngendlela yakho.
Obukhulu kwezi zimbini, bujikelezwe bunyukele ku-0,5 kg olandelayo.

Kwi-app, ivenkile iseta isahluli, inyathelo lokujikeleza neeyunithi zakho (cm okanye ii-intshi, kg okanye i-lb). Iqhosha elithi Kumazwe angaphandle lisebenzisa ÷6000 kubhukisho olunye ngaphandle kokuchukumisa uSeto.
Amakhadi akho amaxabiso, amaxabiso abathengi bakho abaqhelekileyo — nenzuzo yakho kwidokethi nganye.
Inqanaba lokuqala nenqanaba ngalinye elongezelelweyo, ngezowuni nangenkonzo.
Abathumeli abaqhelekileyo bafumana amaxabiso abo; ikhadi elisisiseko ligubungela bonke abanye.
Ixabiso lakho lokuthengisa xa lithelekiswa nexabiso lenkampani yekhuriya, kwidokethi nganye.
I-AWB evela kumaqoqo akho eenombolo. Faka ilebheli, skena, fumana.
Faka uthotho lokuqala–lokugqibela lwenkampani yekhuriya nganye kanye; ukubhukisha ngakunye kuthatha inombolo elandelayo.
I-AWB ibekwa ebhokisini njengebhakhowudi nangamanani acacileyo.
Skena ilebheli ukuze uvule idokethi yayo kwaye wenze okufanelekileyo.
Yinikezele kwinkampani yekhuriya, okanye uthumele umhambisi wakho. Inkqubo efanayo.
Uluhlu lweepasile luqulethe kanye ezo pasile uzikhethileyo — zonke okanye akukho nanye. Ipasile ebhukishwe kwenye inkampani yekhuriya ayinakungena kule ngxowa.
Khetha iipasile, shicilela iphepha lohambo, kwaye umhambisi usebenza kwi-app efanayo kwimowudi yomhambisi — kunye nobungqina bokunikezelwa.
Konke ukuhamba kuyabhalwa — kwaye ukuhamba okunengqiqo kuphela.
Ibhukishiwe → Ikwinkampani yekhuriya → Isendleleni iyahanjiswa → Inikezelwe
→ isizathu → iphinda iphume, okanye ibuyiselwe kumthumeli.
Inikezelwe, ibuyisiwe kwaye irhoxisiwe zizimo zokugqibela.
Izizathu, iinzame, ukuphinda kuphume, okanye ukubuyela kumthumeli.
I-COD onokuyibona: elindelekileyo, enikezelweyo, nefanele ihlawulwe kumthumeli ngamnye.
Kusilele ₹ 200 kuMhambisi B — kuchaziwe, akulahlekanga kwisixa.
Okuqokelelweyo kuthelekiswa nokuhlawulweyo, ngomthumeli ngamnye, namaqoqo okuthunyelwa kwemali.
Incwadi yosuku, ibhili yenyanga nge-akhawunti nganye, kunye nesishwankathelo se-GST nge-CSV esiya kumgcini-zincwadi wakho.
Ukubhukisha, iilebheli, ukuskena, i-COD neencwadi konke kusebenza kwizixhobo zakho. Xa i-intanethi inqamuka, akukho nto kwikhawuntara eyilindileyo.
Ikhawuntara yesibini nefowuni yomhambisi: ziqhagamshelwe nge-Wi-Fi yeofisi
Akukho ntlawulo ngomhambisi, umsebenzisi okanye ipasile. I-Kumkaj Cloud ozikhethelayo: Steady ₹6k · Swift ₹14k · Priority ₹28k/ngonyaka ngaphandle kwerhafu — /shop.
Inkqubo enye yeepasile. Iipasile zakho. Iincwadi zakho.
I-Moklanjo yinkqubo epheleleyo yolawulo lweepasile phantsi kwe-Kumkaj — Android, Windows ne-Linux. Abahambisi basebenzisa i-app efanayo kwimowudi yomhambisi.
Izifaki ziya kubekwa apha xa nganye iphumelele ukufakwa kumatshini omtsha. Okwangoku, cela umboniso kwi-WhatsApp.
Umgca womboniso we-WhatsApp uza kuvuleka kungekudala. Umyalezo wakho uza kufundeka ngolu hlobo: “{message}”.
I-akhawunti enye yesayithi nee-app — ifomu efanayo nokuba umtsha okanye uyabuya.
Siza kukuthumelela ikhonkco lokuseta kwakhona nge-imeyile. Sebenzisa idilesi efanayo obhalise ngayo.
Qhagamshela iindlela kwi-akhawunti enye ukuze ukwazi ukubuyisela ukufikelela ukuba enye iyasilela.
Izicwangciso zelifu zonyaka — irhafu yongezwa xa uhlawula. I-app epheleleyo ye-Moklanjo kwizixhobo zakho ihlala isimahla ngonaphakade, ngaphandle kwezibhengezo.
Inqwelo yakho ayinanto. Yongeza i-Steady, i-Swift okanye i-Priority.
Ukuhlawula kukungenisa kwiphepha le-akhawunti, emva koko kuqalise intlawulo (ukulinganisa kovavanyo okanye i-Paddle xa izitshixo zisetiwe).

Izicwangciso zonyaka — isango lokuhlawula longeza irhafu xa uhlawula. Ukusebenzisa kwisixhobo sakho kuhlala kusimahla ngonaphakade. Okwenziwe ngokwezifiso luqikelelo lwexabiso (lunokuba ngaphantsi kwe-Steady okanye ngaphezu kwe-Priority).
Sebenzisa igama lokugqitha elinoonobumba aba-6 ubuncinane.
Iinzame ezininzi kakhulu. Zama kwakhona kamva.
Sebenzisa inombolo yefowuni epheleleyo enekhowudi yelizwe (umz. +91…).
Loo khowudi ye-SMS ayichanekanga okanye iphelelwe lixesha.
Akukho akhawunti ine-imeyile leyo. Qhubeka ukuze uyenze, okanye usebenzise enye indlela.
Ngenxa yokhuseleko, ngena kwakhona, emva koko uzame olu tshintsho kwakhona.
Loo ndlela yokungena sele isetyenziswa yenye i-akhawunti.
Loo imeyile sele isetyenziswa yenye i-akhawunti.
Loo ndlela sele iqhagamshelwe kule akhawunti.
Sele ikho i-akhawunti ene-imeyile le esebenzisa enye indlela yokungena. Ngena ngaloo ndlela kuqala, uze uqhagamshele le kwiphepha le-akhawunti yakho.
Tshintsha igama lakho lokugqitha. Uza kuqinisekisa ngelangoku.
Yongeza igama lokugqitha ukuze ukwazi ukungena nange-imeyile (kuluncedo ukuba umboneleli akafumaneki).
Akukho mboneleli wokwenyani wokuhlawula ovuliweyo kwi-API yelifu (ukulinganisa kuphela okukwisixhobo sakho).
Ukuhlawula kuvaliwe — akukho ntlawulo igqityiweyo. Isicwangciso sakho asitshintshanga.
I-imeyile ayikaqinisekiswa — jonga ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo
I-akhawunti yenziwe. Jonga i-imeyile yakho ukuze uqinisekise xa ufumana ithuba.
Ukuba ikho i-akhawunti yaloo imeyile, ikhonkco lokuseta kwakhona lisendleleni. Jonga ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
I-akhawunti ka-{email} sele ikho nge-{method}. Ngena ngaloo ndlela kuqala, uze uqhagamshele lo mboneleli kwiphepha le-akhawunti yakho.
Phuma uze ungene kwakhona, emva koko uzame kwakhona.
Faka i-imeyile oza kuyisebenzisa ukungena ngegama lokugqitha.
Igama lokugqitha longeziwe. Ngoku unokungena nange-imeyile.
I-imeyile yokuqinisekisa ithunyelwe — jonga ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
Amaxabiso okuzithengela akakapapashwa kule mveliso. Cela uqikelelo lwexabiso olwenziwe ngokwezifiso okanye ubuye kamva.
Imveliso epheleleyo kwizixhobo zakho. Akukho mali yelifu.
